algorithm: SHA-256(UTF-8 full canonical Dial Record ID); map each of the first seven digest bytes modulo 128.
candidateSemantics: A chant is a collisionable candidate locator only. The complete Dial Record ID and pinned record bytes must verify.
humanInput: Case-insensitive vocabulary words separated by spaces or canonical hyphens.

semantics.accessControl: The chant grants no access and does not change source ACLs.
semantics.activation: Derivation and parsing are inert local operations.
semantics.authority: A chant is a locator only; the full Dial Record ID must verify.
guarantees: Canonical output is exactly seven lowercase vocabulary words joined by hyphens.
Human input accepts case differences and space-separated words.
nonGuarantees: A matching chant does not establish identity, authority, or access.
semantics.purpose: Derive a memorable protocol-neutral locator from a complete Dial Record ID.
